availableCommands.name: context-gatherer
availableCommands.description: Investigates the codebase to answer a specific question about it. Deeply analyzes existing code by tracing execution paths, mapping architecture and abstraction layers, understanding patterns, and documenting dependencies, returning a thorough, direct written analysis that explains how the relevant code works and points to the specific files and lines involved. Use it to understand code before you change it: before designing or implementing a change to code you don't already fully understand, start with context-gatherer so your edits are grounded in how the code actually works. When a task requires understanding code you don't already know, dispatch context-gatherer to do that exploration before running your own searches or reads. Rules: 1. Provide a clear, specific prompt that includes your intent: a detailed task description of the context you need and what you're trying to accomplish. 2. The subagent explores the codebase and returns an analysis of your query 3. Trust the returned results. You may still inspect additional code yourself when you need context beyond what was returned. 4. Reuse existing context-gatherer output for related follow-up questions; do not re-invoke on the same question with different phrasing. 5. For multiple distinct questions, dispatch several context-gatherers in parallel, each targeting a different aspect of the codebase.

availableCommands.name: cad-bom
availableCommands.description: Rolls up an engineering BOM from a STEP AP242 assembly and hw/parts metadata into bom.csv. Triggers on "build the BOM", "EBOM", "bill of materials".

availableCommands.name: cad-concept
availableCommands.description: Iterates 2-4 rough three.js concept variants in a live viewer, then exports the chosen one for CAD. Triggers on "sketch some concepts", "pick a variant".

availableCommands.name: cad-design
availableCommands.description: Grows CAD parts from massing blocks to realistic products through fidelity levels F0-F3, rendered every batch. Triggers on "make it look real", "detail the parts".

availableCommands.name: cad-fits
availableCommands.description: Computes ISO 286 hole/shaft limits, fit type, and 1D worst-case/RSS tolerance stack-ups. Triggers on "what fit for", "H7/g6 limits", "stack-up", "tolerance chain".

availableCommands.name: cad-flow
availableCommands.description: Leads mechanical CAD from a rapid concept through a verified STEP AP242 release. Triggers on take this product from prototype to CAD release.

availableCommands.name: cad-model
availableCommands.description: Builds part model scripts into versioned STEP AP242, GLB, and metrics, then checks or diffs versions. Triggers on "build v3", "check the model", "diff".

availableCommands.name: cad-motion
availableCommands.description: Poses jointed assemblies, sweeps joints for interference, picks the worst-case FEA pose. Triggers on "pose the arm", "sweep the joints", "does it collide".

availableCommands.name: cad-recheck
availableCommands.description: Use when committing a batch of CAD hardware project changes at or after its recheck threshold.

availableCommands.name: cad-record
availableCommands.description: Defines hardware design records, rigor levels and validation. Triggers on how to record or validate a CAD project.

availableCommands.name: cad-render
availableCommands.description: Renders each cad-model version into PBR product PNGs (iso, front, side, exploded, close-ups) for stage gates. Triggers on "render v3", "show me the renders".

availableCommands.name: cad-review-dfm
availableCommands.description: Reviews part manufacturability against its declared FDM or CNC process with measured evidence. Use when a design needs an independent manufacturing review.

availableCommands.name: cad-review-mech
availableCommands.description: Reviews a CAD design for requirements, load paths, mechanics, fits, and FEA with measured evidence. Use when a mechanical design needs independent review.
